title: platformStatus
responsibility: Maps platform declarations to labels and icons for the two platform views.

inputs.name: platformStatus.platform
inputs.description: The selected revision’s PlatformEntry declaration, when one is available. The function reads only status; when omitted, it defaults to undefined and reports not-recorded.

examples.summary: Web platform configuration is not present.

outputs.name: platformViews
outputs.description: The fixed descriptor list for the Web, iOS, Android and Desktop (Electron) platform views, in that order. Each entry contains its id, display name and icon; this list is constant.

outputs.name: unrecorded
outputs.description: The fixed notice for a revision with no recorded platform configuration. This export does not inspect a revision or vary by platform.
examples: No platform configuration is recorded at this revision.

outputs.name: platformStatus
outputs.description: The returned status identifier and fixed label, derived from platform?.status and falling back to not-recorded when that value is nullish. It describes repository configuration only and does not indicate whether a deployment works.
